verdict.rationale: E2B's core purpose is running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes. Its docs state that agent code runs in an isolated Firecracker microVM instead of your server or machine. Developers also get runCode/commands.run execution, kill and timeout controls, configurable CPU/RAM, and outbound network allow/deny controls (internet is on by default but can be restricted). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation guarantees, and in-depth security documentation of the isolation model.
